stories.headline: EU Parliament Approves Landmark Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism Expansion
stories.summary: New regulations expand the CBAM to more industrial sectors, aiming to accelerate global decarbonization efforts and prevent carbon leakage. This significantly impacts international trade.

stories.headline: Asian Tech Giant Unveils Breakthrough in Energy-Efficient AI Processors
stories.summary: A leading company announced a new AI chip architecture significantly reducing power consumption, critical for next-gen data centers and edge computing globally.

stories.headline: New Clinical Trial Results Boost Hope for Universal Malaria Vaccine
stories.summary: Phase 3 trials in several African nations show promising efficacy for a new malaria vaccine candidate, offering hope for eradication efforts and saving millions of lives.

stories.headline: UN Envoy Calls for Urgent Ceasefire Amid Rising Regional Tensions
stories.summary: The UN special envoy urged immediate de-escalation in the Middle East following cross-border skirmishes, emphasizing civilian protection and diplomatic solutions to avert wider conflict.

stories.headline: US Q3 GDP Exceeds Expectations, Signaling Economic Resilience
stories.summary: The Commerce Department reported stronger-than-forecast GDP growth for Q3, indicating robust consumer spending and business investment despite ongoing inflation concerns.
